naming.rule: Name every file by its asset code, then the cast suffix: -ml (Maegan & Landon) or -ac (Andrew & Charlie). Assets marked SHARED need no suffix — one file serves both casts.
naming.photos: JPG (convert HEIC). Long side at least 1600 px. Keep each file under 8 MB so it travels through the Drive connector.
naming.video: MP4 (H.264), 1920×1080, landscape. Videos exceed the Drive transfer limit — upload V2 to the GitHub repo (Add file → Upload files, into assets/) or hand it to the show laptop; tell me which.
naming.audio: M4A or MP3, mono is fine.
naming.folder: One Drive folder, flat, e.g. “L5Y Assets” — tell me when it's there. Missing files are fine: a code that has no file keeps its placeholder, so partial uploads never break the show.
